Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
Degrees
Electrical Engineering and Computer Science Programs
Combine the scientific and research endeavors of electrical and computer engineering with the innovation of computer science for a truly powerful educational experience.
The BS degrees in computer engineering and electrical engineering are accredited by the Engineering Accreditation Commission of ABET, Inc. (www.ABET.org). The BS degrees in computer science and information technology are accredited by the Computing Accreditation Commission of ABET, Inc.
Not sure which major is right for you? Find your path by exploring topics and interests for each program.

Accelerated Programs
Complete both a bachelor’s and master’s in computer science, computer engineering or electrical engineering in just five years. Undergraduate students who have completed at least 90 credit hours and have a 3.0 GPA or higher are eligible to apply for the Accelerated BS to MS Program.
